name: motion-hit-shake
title: Screen Shake on Hit
description: Khung rung mạnh ngay lúc va rồi tắt dần theo hàm mũ trong khoảng nửa giây.

moworks.author: moworks

options.amp: px at the hit (30; 10 on the small frame)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: On a hit: x = sin(97 d) x k, y = cos(83 d) x k with k = 10 px x e^(-9 d), d = seconds since the hit (100 % -> ~26 % at 150 ms -> ~0 at 450 ms); scale 1.04 to hide the edges. Demo: one hit every 1.5 s, at 0.5 s. Params: amp (10 px) · decay (e^−9t) · duration (0.45 s). Call once per hit.
